newsitem.title: USA: Astro-Med says FDA clears monitor system.
newsitem.headline: Astro-Med says FDA clears monitor system.

text.p: Astro-Med Inc said on Friday the FDA cleared its newly designed sleep monitoring device for immediate sale.
The device, called the Albert Grass Heritage - PSG, is a digital polysomnograph that monitors sleep in patients with sleep disorders.
In a statement, the company said it planned to officially introduced the device at an Associated Professional Sleep Societies meeting in San Francisco next month.
It said the device will range in price from $30,000 to $55,000 depending on the number of channels and beds monitored as well as accessories required.
Astro-Med makes high-speed specialty printers for industrial, medical and educational use.
